description: Every clause produced by eliminating one atom from \(\Gamma\) has a resolution derivation from \(\Gamma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.elimination_derivable.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α) (C : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Clause α) :
  C ∈ Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.eliminate p Γ → Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Γ C
